# A player ruler with an Ollamh, a Brehon, a Druid or an Aite at court may see one of their stories.
eir_court_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		OR = {
			employs_court_position = eir_ollamh_court_position
			employs_court_position = eir_brehon_court_position
			employs_court_position = eir_druid_court_position
			employs_court_position = eir_foster_father_court_position
		}
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 12
		1 = eir.1001
		1 = eir.1002
		1 = eir.1003
		1 = eir.1004
		1 = eir.1005
		1 = eir.1006
		1 = eir.1007
		1 = eir.1008
		1 = eir.1009
		1 = eir.1010
		1 = eir.1011
		1 = eir.1012
	}
}

# A Druidic ruler, or one who has founded the Culdee Reform, may see a story of their faith.
eir_faith_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		OR = {
			faith = faith:eir_druidic
			has_character_modifier = eir_culdee_reform_modifier
		}
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.1013
		1 = eir.1014
		1 = eir.1015
		1 = eir.1016
		1 = eir.1017
		1 = eir.1018
	}
}
